answer: Pearl admits a yarrow only with signatures from three branches chosen by hashing that yarrow's key, each signer burning saffron equal to the live yarrow count in its own branch, read fresh at commit, and no signer attests twice in one epoch. An attacker cannot choose friendly signers, so a thousand fakes require 3,000 signatures from strangers, and every signature carries an independently rising burn. The bill is saffron per signature, attached to each pearl admission. It fails if branches can be spun up cheaply or attestations resold.
